kebab_example: aliyun apig create-ai-model-card --gateway-id gw-8c13d2b4f8a1 --model-provider qwen --model-name qwen-plus --credit inputCost=1.5 outputCost=3 cacheCost=0.5 type=fixed --features '{"toolChoice":true,"promptCaching":false,"functionCalling":true}' --meta '{"maxInputTokens":131072,"supportedOutputModalities":["text"],"maxTokens":131072,"supportedInputModalities":["text","image"],"maxOutputTokens":8192}' --available-paths path=/v1/chat/completions type=OpenAICompatible --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAiModelCard

fields.help_en: The model invocation path. The value can be up to 2048 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 路径。模型调用路径，长度不超过2048个字符
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: The protocol type corresponding to the path. The value can be up to 64 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 路径对应的协议类型，长度不超过64个字符
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The list of API paths supported by the model. Each item must include both path and type
parameters.help_zh: API路径模型支持的调用路径列表。每一项必须同时包含path和type
parameters.name: available_paths

fields.help_en: The cache hit token cost, in Credits per million tokens. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. If not specified, the value defaults to 0
fields.help_zh: 缓存命中Token费用，单位为Credits/百万Token。取值必须大于或等于0，不传时默认为0
fields.name: cache_cost

fields.help_en: The input token cost, in Credits per million tokens. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. If not specified, the value defaults to 0
fields.help_zh: 输入Token费用，单位为Credits/百万Token。取值必须大于或等于0，不传时默认为0
fields.name: input_cost

fields.help_en: The output token cost, in Credits per million tokens. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. If not specified, the value defaults to 0
fields.help_zh: 输出Token费用，单位为Credits/百万Token。取值必须大于或等于0，不传时默认为0
fields.name: output_cost

fields.help_en: The billing type. Currently, only fixed is supported. If not specified, the value defaults to fixed
fields.help_zh: 计费类型。当前仅支持fixed；不传时默认为fixed
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The credit billing information of the model. Currently, only the fixed type is supported. The cost unit is Credits per million tokens. If not specified, all cost values default to 0
parameters.help_zh: 模型的Credit计费信息。当前仅支持fixed类型，费用单位为Credits/百万Token；不传时各项费用默认为0
parameters.name: credit

parameters.help_en: The model capability switches. Keys must be model capability names supported by API Gateway, and values must be Boolean
parameters.help_zh: 模型能力开关。键必须是API网关支持的模型能力名称，值为布尔值
parameters.name: features

parameters.help_en: The AI gateway instance ID. The target instance must exist, belong to the current account, and be of the AI gateway type
parameters.help_zh: AI网关实例ID。目标实例必须存在、属于当前账号且类型为AI网关
parameters.name: gateway_id

fields.help_en: The maximum number of input tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
fields.help_zh: 模型支持的最大输入Token数。取值必须大于或等于0
fields.name: max_input_tokens

fields.help_en: The maximum number of output tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
fields.help_zh: 模型支持的最大输出Token数。取值必须大于或等于0
fields.name: max_output_tokens

fields.help_en: The maximum total number of context tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
fields.help_zh: Token总量上限模型支持的上下文最大Token总数。取值必须大于或等于0
fields.name: max_tokens

fields.help_en: The list of input modalities supported by the model. The list can contain up to 16 items, and each item must not be empty
fields.help_zh: 模型支持的输入模态列表，最多包含16项，每一项均不能为空
fields.name: supported_input_modalities

fields.help_en: The list of output modalities supported by the model. The list can contain up to 16 items, and each item must not be empty
fields.help_zh: 模型支持的输出模态列表，最多包含16项，每一项均不能为空
fields.name: supported_output_modalities

parameters.help_en: The token limits and input/output modality information of the model
parameters.help_zh: 模型的Token上限和输入、输出模态信息
parameters.name: meta

parameters.help_en: The model name. The model name must be unique within the same AI gateway instance and the same model provider. The value can be up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 模型名称。同一AI网关实例、同一模型供应商下模型名称必须唯一，长度不超过256个字符
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The model provider identifier. The value must reference an existing model provider in the target AI gateway instance. The value can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 模型供应商标识。必须引用目标AI网关实例中已存在的模型供应商，长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: model_provider
